scope: A rights/provenance review of current EOS parameters and structural/diffraction components, not a new source license or a distribution exclusion policy.
limits: Assessment concerns the existing normalized numerical records and cited lineage; no fresh transcription or legal clearance of every original publication is claimed.
Copyright in expression, independent collection/database rights and acquisition contracts are separate. No universal number-of-rows exemption is used.
Unknown original terms remain unknown. An article or deposit grant does not automatically cover an entire material.
No new contributor dedication or source grant is made; retain existing scoped notices and scientific qualifications.

The remaining 17 unresolved components remain in the current runtime export; this review does not silently remove structures, peaks or EOS records. They require a follow-up before claiming an entirely cleared archive.
The dataset selection, including five held original entries, is unchanged. Previously published archives and historical inventory rows remain historical evidence.

The ten inherited arrays were subsequently replaced by independent calculations. Original arrays/full records remain private with hashes; generated intensity patterns are not measurements. dioptas.scope: Upstream contributor-held software/documentation and compilation contributions only. No inferred grant of third-party publications, card collections or acquisition contracts.

thermodynamic_source.finding: Fresh official ds62 bytes match the historical scientific audit. The 256-endmember artifact and bundle README supply no explicit redistribution license. post_perovskite_cod_replacement.scope: Two structural sources independently replaced with COD 9009217. All numeric/scientific model values unchanged; prior EOS decisions and remaining collection cases unchanged.

Input models, source checksums, proxy/occupancy limits and omitted corrections are explicit in calculated-pattern-inputs.json. rationales.numerical_parameter_assessment: Normalized numerical EOS coefficients, uncertainty/convention metadata and independently implemented equations, with source attribution. rationales.numerical_structure_assessment: Normalized lattice, symmetry, coordinate/occupancy or explicitly idealized structural facts.
